caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped tin container with a blue base color. The surface of the tin is decorated with a cityscape illustration that wraps around its sides. The cityscape features several multi-story buildings with numerous windows, rendered in shades of cream, beige, and brown, with blue shadows and outlines. There are also a few dark trees and smaller details suggesting streets, rooftops, and distant buildings. The sky on the tin is depicted in various hues of blue with white clouds or light streaks. The top edge of the tin has a decorative border with a swirling pattern in blue, brown, and beige. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, emphasizing the container as the central object. There is a small signature at the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Bandbox
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
